decisions.why: read all 4 examples (Finger/Toe Goniometer, Orfit Sharp Scissors, Bunnel Reverse Finger Knuckle Bender, Splint Pan Netting) — orthotic fabrication/fitting tools and materials, no unrelated items
all 4 examples (Double Bedford Finger Stall, Paediatric Thumb Splint, Duo Splint Wrist & Thumb Brace, Comfort Cool Firm D-ring Wrist & Thumb) are upper-limb splints/braces
division name plus 3 of 4 examples (Universal Toe Adjustment Splint, Heel Relief Shoe, LNK-Up) are ankle-foot orthoses/footwear; the fourth (Traverse Hygiene Cover) is an accessory to the same range
all 4 examples (Neobrace Plus, Jura Basic, Jura Universal, ProFlex 4000) are wrist splints/braces
all 4 examples (Air X Long ROM Knee Brace, Aspen OA Knee Wrap, Wraparound Hinged Knee, Aspen Ci Knee) are knee braces
all 4 examples (Vista II CTLSO, Vista II Cervical Collar, Vista Collar Large Back Panel, Vista CTO4) are cervical/trunk orthoses
all 4 examples are Aspen cervical collars
all 4 examples (Contour TLSO SPK, Contour LSO) are spinal orthoses
all 4 examples are replacement pads for collars/braces (Aspen CTO, Vista MultiPost, Vista ICU) — componentry, and 'pads' is named explicitly in the orthotics:materials vocabulary description
all 4 examples (Cotton Sling with D-Ring, Sling Strap, Arm Elevator Sling, Jura Abduction Sling Plus) are arm/shoulder slings
all 4 examples (Aspen TLSO, TLSO Upgrade Kit, LSO LoPro, LSO) are lumbar/thoracic orthoses
all 4 examples (Isotoner Therapeutic Gloves, Oedema Gloves, Thermoskin Dynamic Compression Gloves, OrthoThermic Gloves) are therapeutic/compression gloves for hand and arm conditions
all 4 examples (Popple LSO Maternity Brace, Wiltshire Maternity Belt, Pelvic Instability Belt, Maternity Belt Style C) are lumbar/pelvic support orthoses

despite the division name, all 4 examples (Vari Pad Tennis Elbow Support, Neoprene Shoulder Brace, Subluxation Cuff, Jura Clavicle Splint) are elbow/shoulder/clavicle products, not cervical — mapped on the evidence, not the label
all 4 examples (Abdominal Binder Universal, FLX 631/456/464 LSO/TLSO) are lumbar/thoracic orthoses
all 4 examples (Horizon PRO 464/456 TLSO, Elite TLSO, Horizon 637 LSO) are spinal orthoses — a branded product line, not a real sub-category, but genuinely all spine
3 of 4 examples (Comfort Cool Ulnar Nerve Elbow Protector, Progress Elbow Hinge Splint, Foam Pad Elbow/Heel Protector) are elbow orthoses; division name and majority evidence point to upper limb
3 of 4 examples (Philly Collar, Halton Collar, Budget Collar) are cervical collars
division name is literally Paediatric and all 4 examples are Aspen Paediatric Collar products, matching the orthotics:paed vocabulary type directly
all 4 examples (Nhyco Cruciform Hyperextension Orthosis, MP45 Plus 3-Point Hyperextension Brace, Proform Belt, Pro Tem Belt) are spinal orthoses/support belts
all 4 examples are Aspen Sierra TLSO/LSO spinal orthoses — a branded product line
all 3 examples (FLX Universal Extension Panel, Horizon Extension Panels, QuikDraw/Contour RAP Black Extension Panel) are componentry for spinal orthoses, not the orthosis itself

all 3 examples (Vista MultiPost Therapy Collar Replacement Therapy Pack, Aspen Therapy Pack, QuikDraw/Contour Cold Therapy Pack) are hot/cold therapy packs, matching rehab:therapy (therapy and exercise equipment) rather than an orthosis itself
all 3 examples (Vista 464 TLSO Upgrade Kit, Vista 464 TLSO, Aspen Extension Panel) are spinal orthoses/componentry for the same range
both examples (Deluxe Palm Protector, Progress Palm Protector) are hand protection orthoses
both examples (Summit 456 TLSO, Summit 637 LSO) are spinal orthoses — a branded product line
both examples (Aspen Tri-Point FSO Dual Configuration Kit, Aspen Tri-Point FSO) are spinal orthoses (FSO = flexion support orthosis, an Aspen spinal brace line)
both examples (Goniometer, Juraprene Splinting Material) are orthotic fabrication tools/materials
sole example (Resistance Band 45m) is therapy/exercise equipment
